definitions.meaning: to speak ill of, to abuse

quotations.old_english: Swá firenfulle fácnum wordum heora aldorðægn unreordadon (on reordadon? v. on, B. III. 5)

source_text: un-reordian (?) to speak ill of, to abuse :-- Swá firenfulle fácnum wordum heora aldorðægn unreordadon (on reordadon? v. on, B. III. 5), Cd. Th. 269, 1; Sat. 66.
